review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–74) and grepped the Quantum directory for uses of QMAGridCell. The file defines three things. QMAGridCell is an abbreviation for a product of two Fin types. qmaTaggedSweepFrom is a recursive definition specific to the QMA circuit. The other three declarations are lemmas about it. The abbreviation is a local alias that is used widely in the project, and I found no Mathlib concept that it competes with. The sweep is built on the project's own qmaTaggedRowStage and qmaSweepCircuitFrom, which are domain-specific. It pairs each gate with a row and column label, and a lemma relates it to the untagged circuit. I found no independent Mathlib or core definition of the same concept, and no sign of repeated conversions. I did not read the support file's definitions in full. I found no justified finding.
